title: Genome-resolved metagenomic dataset of Korean agricultural soils exposed to PLA–PBAT biodegradable mulch film: plastizyme screen of field MAGs
description: Scripts, reference sequences and results of the plastizyme screen (putative PLA- and PBAT-degrading enzymes) of metagenome-assembled genomes from two South Korean agricultural soils with contrasting biodegradable mulch film (BMF) histories (Yeoju, no BMF use; Jeonju, multi-year BMF use). Accompanies the Scientific Data Data Descriptor of the same title.
